symptoms: Exudation of dark reddish-brown gummy fluid from trunk base; basal bark decay; outer leaves yellow, droop and hang skirt-like around stem; bracket-shaped fungal fructifications (conks) emerge at trunk base.
management: Consult local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for registered treatment.
prevention: Practice crop rotation, field hygiene, and use certified seeds.

symptoms: Central spindle leaf yellows, turns brown and rots; foul decaying odor from crown heart; spindle easily slips out upon gentle pull; death of palm if heart bud decays.
management: Consult local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for registered treatment.
prevention: Practice crop rotation, field hygiene, and use certified seeds.

symptoms: Characteristic visual lesions, discoloration or foliar distress associated with Bud Root Dropping.
management: Isolate affected foliage, apply approved bio-fungicide or targeted treatment.
prevention: Implement crop rotation, avoid water stagnation, and sanitize farm implements regularly.
